standard-dialogue.text: If the player did not speak to Elias at the Uzer Oasis prior to 21 February 2024:

steps.npc: The eternal quest for knowledge, of course! The name's Elias White. I'm something of an explorer.

steps.player: Pleased to meet you. I'm [player name]. So you're searching for knowledge in an inn?

steps.npc: Not exactly. In fact, I was previously hunting down information on an ancient race deep within the desert.
However, I received an interesting yet concerning tip- off from a contact of mine regarding some of my research. I came here to investigate for myself.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player spoke to Elias at the Uzer Oasis before 21 February 2024:

steps.npc: Oh, hello there. You look familiar. Have we met before?

steps.player: I think so. The name's [player name]. You're Elias, right? You had a camp out near Uzer.

steps.npc: Ah, of course. You offered to help with my work, didn't you? I'm still very keen to take you up on that offer at some point, but a more pressing matter has delayed that somewhat.

steps.player: Is that what's brought you here?

steps.npc: Indeed. I recived an interesting yet concerning tip-off from a contact of mine regarding some of my research. I came here to investigate for myself.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player does not meet the quest's requirements:

steps.npc: How kind of you to offer. I'm not in need of any extra help right now though.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player meets the quest's requirements:

steps.npc: How kind of you to offer. I definitely wouldn't complain about some extra support, if you're sure you're interested?

standard-dialogue.prompt: Start the Defender of Varrock quest?

steps.player: Absolutely! So what was this tip-off you received?

steps.npc: Very well. If you change your mind, I'll be here.

standard-dialogue-after-defender-of-varr.npc: Ah, hello there, [player name]. Good to see you.

standard-dialogue-after-defender-of-varr.player: And you, Elias. So you're back out here again?

standard-dialogue-after-defender-of-varr.npc: Indeed. Turns out the desert was the best place to begin my research into Arrav and his heart. Not too surprising of course, given the burial practices here.
In fact, as you might recall, I was here before to look into that old mastaba up on the plateau.

standard-dialogue-after-defender-of-varr.player: Yes, I remember. You said it might contain important information on the Mahjarrat.

standard-dialogue-after-defender-of-varr.npc: Indeed I did. And I reckon it might also contain the knowledge we need to help old Arrav out.
Now, I still have quite a bit of preparatory work to do before we consider heading inside, but once that's done, I'll be in touch.

standard-dialogue-after-defender-of-varr.player: Sounds good. I'd best leave you to your work.

historical-dialogue.player: What brings you all the way out here?

historical-dialogue.npc: The eternal quest for knowledge, of course! The name's Elias White. I'm something of an explorer.

options.text: Are you searching for something here?

steps.player: Are you searching for something here?

steps.npc: Of course. As I said, my search is for knowledge.
Information lost to the ages. Specifically, information on an ancient race.

steps.player: And you expect to find something here?

steps.npc: Not quite here, but up on the plateau. There's an old mastaba up there that I believe dates from a time when the race resided in these lands.

steps.player: Well if you ever need help raiding an ancient tomb, I reckon I can be of service.

steps.npc: A generous offer! I still have quite a bit of preparatory work to do before I dare head inside, but once that's done, maybe we can work something out.
Ah, I've lived in many places over the years, but I wouldn't really say I have a home. I guess Varrock would be the closest answer.

steps.player: Sounds like you have quite the history.

steps.npc: Oh yes! If nothing else, I've definitely lived a varied life.

steps.player: So you weren't always an explorer?

steps.npc: Not at all. I've done all sorts of things in my time. In fact, at one point I was an adventurer like you!

steps.player: What happened? Some sort of life-changing injury?

steps.npc: Thankfully not. I just found that when it came to my work, it was the history I discovered that interested me more than the treasure.

options.text: Are you searching for something here?
